about.title: About Us
about.intro: Axion is an engineering firm that distributes and integrates industrial automation technology from leading international brands.
body: We design, supply, commission and support control systems for water, power, marine and manufacturing clients.
Our engineers work from concept to handover — and stay on for the maintenance that keeps plants running.
